In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], a  '''skirmish''' occurred between the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'' and a [[Creysis's scout squadron|scout squadron]] of [[Ebruchi]] [[Unidentified Ebruchi clan|clan]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The battle was one-sided as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] easily destroyed almost all of the Ebruchi ships, with only eight escaping. Following this skirmish, the ''Admonitor'' was able to track down one of the escaping fighters to the location of the Ebruchi's leader.
